title: Sable and the Alibi
author: Jude Zhou
blurb: Tamsin Ravensworth, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
